subject: QBR prep: account-level telemetry, consolidated forecast & escalation plan
messages:
From: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR data ask + one-pager request

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well — our QBR with execs is scheduled for June 15 and the execs asked for a single-page summary per account plus the consolidated forecast (ARR and timing) for the next quarter. Can you share Redwood’s account-level one-pagers (revenue runway, open risks, next milestones) and the consolidated forecast by the 10th?

Two quick asks we need to align on before the deck:
- A clear callout for any technical risks (security/compliance or performance) that could impact go-live timing.
- Any procurement blockers on our side (contract redlines, SOC items) that would change the close date.

Attaching our internal QBR checklist so you see the layout we’ll use (we’ll slot Redwood’s one-pagers into slide 7–9).

Thanks — Sarah

Attachment: acme_qbr_prep_checklist.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: QBR data ask + one-pager request

Team — looping you in. Per Sarah: they need account one-pagers + consolidated forecast by EOD 10th. High priority.

Requesting the following:
1) Karthik — can you pull the account telemetry export (usage, latency percentiles, token volumes) and generate the per-account one-pager draft? Use the "QBR one-pager" template in Drive.
2) Marissa — please consolidate our forecast for the quarter (ARR, probability-weighted close month) and call out any movement vs last forecast. Add a row for procurement open items per account.
3) Tessa — specially ask CS to confirm planned milestones and any customer-identified risks. Laura — please review the pricing/discount impacts and confirm the committed ARR number.

Timeline: initial drafts by EOD Monday (6/8), final packet by 6/10. If anything will miss the timeline, flag here ASAP so we can escalate.

I’ll handle the executive-facing summary once you hand me drafts — I want these to be short, risk-forward, and include a recommended ask (e.g., approve a 30-day pilot, push procurement item X, or finance credit).

Thanks — Vivek

Signature: Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: QBR data ask + one-pager request

Vivek — uploaded a first pass to the shared folder (see link below). I pulled the telemetry export for May, ran the latency and token-volume rollups, and filled the per-account one-pager fields. Notes:
- Acme Corp: 95th p95 latency spike on 5/12 tied to a model switch; engineering already deployed a soft-fix. No customer-facing outages.
- BetaHealth: token growth +120% month-over-month; recommend increasing burst capacity to avoid throttling risk.
- Zephyr: stable but low volume; procurement delay remains the main close risk.

Attachments: qbr_account_summary_vivek.xlsx (XLSX, 420KB); acme_account_telemetry_2026-05.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRprepAcme

On Mon, Jun 8, 2026 at 07:55 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Vivek / Karthik — attaching my consolidated forecast workbook (sheet: probability-weighted). I adjusted close months for Acme from Jul -> Aug given procurement signal from Ben (email below).
>
> --Marissa

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: QBR data ask + one-pager request

Quick summary from forecasting:
- Consolidated probability-weighted ARR (next quarter): $4.3M
- Committed vs prior forecast: -$380K variance (main delta: Acme shifting close from Jul -> Aug)
- Material risks: Acme procurement (contracting language around data retention), BetaHealth potential pricing pushback, and a possible 10% churn risk in a small pilot account if latency remains >150ms p95.

I added a procurement column in the workbook with owner and blocker detail (Ben at Acme indicated SOC 2 evidence will need an additional week). Proposed mitigations are in the "actions" column per account.

Attachment: consolidated_forecast_q3_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

On Mon, Jun 8, 2026 at 08:30 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks — will review and assemble.

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: QBR data ask + one-pager request

Sarah / Ben — thanks for the deadline clarity. We’ve uploaded account one-pagers and a consolidated probability-weighted forecast to the shared Drive (link below). Highlights for your QBR deck:

- Acme Corp: revised expected close to August. Technical risk: p95 latency spike on 5/12; engineering has a mitigation in staging and we recommend a 30-day pilot extension to validate the fix before full go-live. Procurement: awaiting SOC 2 evidence (Ben expected to confirm timeline).
- Recommended ask for QBR: Approve pilot extension + sign-off to begin procurement exchange of SOC evidence to expedite August close.
- Consolidated forecast (next quarter): $4.3M probability-weighted. Variance vs prior forecast: -$380K (driven by Acme timing).

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRprepAcme
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/RDW-2026-ACME-27

Next steps:
- Ben: please confirm SOC 2 evidence ETA so we can reflect in the slide update.
- Karthik: please export the one-pagers to PDF for slide import and send final files by Wed 6/10 12:00pm PT.
- Marissa: lock the forecast sheet and add a one-line commentary for the exec slide.

If there are any blockers, flag here and we’ll escalate to Solutions or Legal.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: qbr_account_summary_vivek.xlsx (PDF export pending)
